title: Chemoresistant Orthotopic Triple-Negative Breast Cancer PDX Model Protocol
author: Tébar-García, Barbella-Aponte, et al.

steps.title: Purchase NSG founder mice
steps.instruction: Purchase three founder pairs of NSG mice (3 males and 3 females, 35–41 days old) from a commercial breeder to establish an NSG breeder colony. Optional: alternatively purchase 5–6‑week‑old female NSG mice directly from an accredited commercial breeder.

steps.title: Identify and collect female mice
steps.instruction: Identify and house males and females separately and collect female NSG mice when they reach 5–6 weeks of age.

steps.title: House mice under standard conditions
steps.instruction: Group‑house mice (5–6 per cage) in climate‑controlled, individually ventilated cages with aspen‑chip bedding; maintain a 12:12 h light‑dark cycle; keep ambient temperature at 22 ± 2 °C and relative humidity 30%–70%; provide ad libitum access to irradiation‑sterilized food and water.

steps.title: Maintain SPF environment
steps.instruction: Keep mice under specific pathogen‑free (SPF) conditions within the animal facility.

steps.title: Prepare required solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare all solutions listed in the Materials and Equipment section before starting each experimental procedure.

steps.title: Collect and document tumor sample
steps.instruction: Collect the patient tumor sample directly from the responsible clinician, confirm diagnostic coverage, and record the collection date, clinician’s name, patient identifier, and sample type in the Sample Collection Log.

steps.title: Remove vessels and necrotic tissue
steps.instruction: Under sterile conditions, remove large blood vessels, necrotic areas, and excess stroma; thoroughly eliminate all necrotic regions (necrotic tissue appears white, viable tissue is beige to yellow and firmer).

steps.title: Wash tumor in antibiotic PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the tumor twice in PBS supplemented with penicillin/streptomycin, ciprofloxacin, and amphotericin B for 5–10 minutes each wash.

steps.title: Incubate tumor in antibiotic DMEM
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample for at least 2 hours in phenol‑red‑free DMEM containing penicillin/streptomycin, ciprofloxacin, and amphotericin B to reduce microbial contamination. Optional: store the tumor for up to 16 hours at 4 °C in this medium; if using cryopreserved material, thaw directly in FBS with antibiotics and incubate 16–24 hours at 4 °C.

steps.title: Section tumor into fragments
steps.instruction: In a laminar‑flow hood, cut the tumor into approximately 3 × 3 mm fragments using a sterile scalpel. Optional: cryopreserve fragments at –80 °C or in liquid nitrogen using the described freezing medium.
